name: Ultimate Valkyrie
description: The Valkyrie line taken as far as it goes. Every gram of it is pointed forward — 165 Attack over a 40 Defence, a blade that has no answer to being hit and does not intend to need one. Swung unmastered it burns through its own spin to do it.

ability.name: Ultimate Blade
ability.description: Pure offence. Every Attack that lands hits for +13%, every hit of the Special for +10%, and the crit rate is raised by 15%. Until Ultimate Valkyrie is mastered, Attack and Special each drain 35% more stamina. At bey level 100 the surcharge is removed. Its Special ignores Defense for that turn.

rules._note: on_hit is the per-Special-hit trigger; on_attack_hit is the normal-attack one. They are disjoint, so this does not stack with the rule above on a single swing.
The drawback, and ONLY the drawback, is gated on level. At 100 this rule stops firing and the offence rules above are untouched.

special_move.name: Ultimate V
special_move.description: Five cuts along the same line, carved into the shape of a V. The guard is not gone through — it is gone past.
flavour_texts: ⚡ **ULTIMATE V** — five cuts down the same line!
🗡️ The V closes — there is nothing left to guard with!
